//Auth: Used only by AuthRateLimitTest, which needs a genuinely low limit so it can
prove the limiter refuses a flood over HTTP.
It is a separate environment rather than a value the test factory injects,
because Program.cs reads this while building the host — before the factory's
configuration callbacks run — so an appsettings file is the only source that
arrives in time. The rest of the suite runs under Testing, where the limit is
raised out of the way instead.
